p: day: That is, after the Jews had begun to fast.
held out to Esther the golden: Which was a sign that her coming was agreeable to him, Es 4:11.
given thee to the half of: Meaning by this that whatever she asked would be granted as in Mr 6:23.
wine: Because they used to drink excessively in their banquets they called the banquet by that which was most in use or esteemed.
said: I will declare what I demand.
promoted him: Thus the wicked when they are promoted instead of acknowledging their charge and humbling themselves, wax ambitious, disdainful and cruel.
cubits high: Meaning, the highest that could be found.
